purpose: Changed closed-loop parameters retreat: vx -0.35, vy 0, 1.6 s, public BODY50 gyro heading feedback with a frozen positive (left) target heading offset during the active walk only, neutral head, then exactly zero. Not a gate relaxation; measurement and final shooting gate untouched. No training, no ball, no task success claim.
derived_from: claude-football-backward-feedback-v120-v1/parameters (feedback probe v1: audits pass, 8 survive, 3/4 per duration, no eligible case); only change: per-world desired heading offset initialising heading and heading_lp
predeclaration_source: Root 2026-10-21 approval after football-backward-feedback-probe-v1 (root-final-decision-v1.json). Seed 981131 reserved; 981129/981130 Stage B remain unrun.
sensor: finite BODY50 tau2 (sensors/processing/body50_finite_range), vector producer; not a hardware calibration
preparation: Actual native raw/zero body/neutral head, original physical fixture, all worlds retained. No task support, no reset, no state write.
fixed_condition: Same nominal white/orange USD, 7.4V, 4-substep delay, original motor/friction/limits. Parallel initial trajectories may differ; no cross-world bitwise identity claim.

motion.command: [vx, 0, wz(public heading feedback)] for exactly round(command_duration_s*50) policy steps from step 250 unless the world faults; exactly zero before, at/after the stop step and after a fault (latched); no ramp, no post-stop or quiet correction, no after-stop turn
motion.head: native head command exactly zero for the whole task (v3 HeadSetpointFeedback with nominal 0 and feedback disabled)
motion.control: Closed-loop on the same delivered BODY50 packet the actor observes; private pose is evaluation only.

endpoints.frame: start heading frame: root XY and yaw at state index 999 (task 5.000 s, last tick before movement)
endpoints.onset: first state index >= 1000 whose start-frame dx <= -0.01 m; onset_s = its task time minus 5.0
endpoints.stop: state index 4*(250+move_steps)-1 (last tick of the last commanded policy step)
endpoints.public_odometry: frozen public adapter v2 + v117 SoleContactLegOdometry replay of the recorded packets; displacement between the reads at policy steps 250 and the stop step vs truth between the same physics instants

frozen_gates_per_world.passive_soft_limit: reported per joint (peak/P95/P99/fraction/duration) under football-physics-semantics-v2; diagnostic, not a gate

selection: A case is eligible only if ALL 4 worlds pass every frozen gate AND the independent audit passed. Choose the eligible case with the smaller offset (+0.10 before +0.20). No eligible case => no adoption, no integration, no workaround.
scope: No RGB/ToF, no ball, no autonomous success, no Stage B. Probe gates are not the full-task 70% target. Model weights unchanged.

heading_feedback.rate: dot(gyro_body, -gravity_body/||gravity_body||) from the same delivered packet; ||gravity|| >= 0.5 and finite
heading_feedback.entry: heading = heading_lp = desired_heading_offset_rad of the world (positive = desired actual yaw LEFT of the movement-entry heading), rate_lp = current rate; wz = clip(2.5*offset - 0.25*rate) at the first active tick
heading_feedback.integration: on each new read: heading = wrap(heading - rate*(read_s - previous_read_s)); unchanged duplicate: no integration
heading_feedback.lp_timing: both LPs update on every active policy tick after entry with the policy clock dt (v117 track_filtered convention); nominally read dt = policy dt = 0.02 s
heading_feedback.faults: invalid/unready packet, nonfinite/null gravity or gyro, stale/future/noncausal clocks, non-monotone seq/read, changed duplicate, read gap > 0.025 s, policy clock gap -> immediate zero, latched, world cannot pass; any fault fails the audit (adoption fails)
heading_feedback.offset_scope: Only the entry value of the goal-relative reference changes; gyro integration, LPs, gains, clamp, timing, freshness and faults are identical to v120. No post-stop authority, no ramp.
